coreClaim: A cold-cache generated message create reuses the bounded append checkpoint instead of synchronously recovering and rewriting both large message primaries.

inScope: Atomic messages and message-swipes append checkpoint

claimBoundary.coreClaim: An uncached id-less messages create joins the existing append checkpoint lifecycle and appends bounded bytes without materializing messages.json or message-swipes.json.
outOfScopeClaims: No journal format or replay semantics change.
Chats retain their existing cold append path.
A non-appendable messages primary still uses the validated recovery fallback.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: After an atomic messages and message-swipes append left a durable checkpoint, the next cold-cache id-less message create called single-collection append recovery. That recovery materialized both large primaries in the foreground before appending the new message.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A bounded append fast path must not turn an already-applied checkpoint into a full-primary rewrite during foreground generation.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Cold uncached messages creates first use append_many_uncached_locked for a one-collection append. The existing checkpoint remains durable and startup-replayable while both primary file identities stay unchanged.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: FileStorage owns create routing, atomic append checkpoints, in-place append application, and startup recovery.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not suppress persistence, weaken file sync, hide the wait in UI state, or duplicate checkpoint logic in the Conversation engine.
regressionProof: Create an initial atomic messages and message-swipes append so the checkpoint is non-empty.
Create an id-less message while the messages collection remains uncached.
Both primary identities remain unchanged and the checkpoint remains non-empty.
A fresh FileStorage instance recovers the checkpoint and can read the created message.

positiveRows.claim: Cold message create reuses the pending append checkpoint without rewriting either primary.
The created message survives checkpoint recovery.
positiveRows.evidence: The same regression reopens FileStorage and reads the generated id after recovery.

contradictionRows.claim: The optimization must not discard or prematurely clear checkpoint evidence.
contradictionRows.evidence: The regression asserts the checkpoint remains non-empty until a fresh instance performs recovery.

contradictionRows.claim: Existing atomic multi-collection append behavior must remain intact.
contradictionRows.evidence: The full marinara-storage suite passes all atomic append, partial apply, corruption, and recovery tests.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Cold chat creates and non-appendable message files retain their existing fallback behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The original append_collection_row fallback remains after the messages checkpoint fast path.

untestedRows: Post-merge Raspberry Pi Conversation timing and primary-file identity are verified after the matching ARM64 image is deployed.

ownedFacts.description: On exact Pi merge f1c87dcb, Conversation completed in 21.873 seconds and its measured message creates each completed in under 0.2 seconds.
ownedFacts.evidence: Browser elapsed timing and DE_KOI_PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSTICS storage.operation spans.

ownedFacts.description: During that Conversation turn, messages.json and message-swipes.json were both replaced at 23:17:27 UTC by a cold-cache message create that began at 23:17:27.515 UTC.
ownedFacts.evidence: Pi file identities and mtimes matched the 102.761 ms messages create span.

ownedFacts.description: The cold single-row append calls append_journal::recover for checkpoint-tracked collections, while append_many_uncached_locked extends the existing checkpoint and applies only bounded in-place appends.
ownedFacts.evidence: Derived from create_locked, append_collection_row, append_many_uncached_locked, and append_journal::append_transaction.
